cause.R1-002: A real crash after the refund effect left Mastra's request-approval checkpoint suspended while its run snapshot was running. restart() re-entered the checkpoint with no resumeData, generated a new command, and suspended again. The dispatch backfill path also retried recursively after a UNIQUE collision.
cause.R1-005: Lease ownership was checked only on individual row updates. Terminal case projections happened separately, so a stale worker could project failure after delivery or after another owner advanced a dispatch. Approval resume also had no lease heartbeat.
cause.R1-008: support_events retained a global physical primary key even after its logical lookup became tenant/account scoped.
cause.R1-011: The loopback facade coerced delivery fields and left support-normalization and knowledge-list responses unvalidated.
cause.R2-001: A successful fixture seed promise remained cached after reset, so a same-instance seed returned the obsolete memo instead of restoring fixtures.

R1-002: request-approval recovers an already persisted decision when restart supplies no resumeData, including an explicit rejected decision.
An approved recovered decision recomputes its fingerprint and requires byte-equivalent persisted immutable refund-command action data before the effect can replay.
claimDispatchForResume now performs one bounded reread after a backfill UNIQUE race and returns conflict when the row is no longer suspended.
R1-005: Approval resume renews its 30-second dispatch lease every 10 seconds and returns 409 if the heartbeat loses ownership.
failDispatchAndCase and terminal outbox retries update the fenced durable row and public case projection in one write transaction.
Exhausted dispatch/outbox projections use the same conditional transition and transaction, preventing stale SELECT-to-UPDATE case corruption.
R1-008: CaseStore derives a deterministic SHA-256 physical event/dispatch id from tenant, account, and supplied event id; acceptance still deduplicates on the scoped logical provider identity.
R1-011: The facade validates every request and response for support, commerce, transactions, and knowledge ports. Delivery no longer String-coerces malformed body/status; HTTP adapters parse normalizeInbound and listChanged responses.
R2-001: Seed/reset operations are serialized per tenant/account. A reset invalidates its memo only after commit, so seed-reset-seed restores the fixture set while refused resets preserve history and memo.

evidence.result: Real archived init process reached the persisted financial effect and deliberately exited immediately afterward.
Second real process retained recovery-run, resolved the same case, replayed the refund (status skipped), and persisted refunds=1,outbox=1,deliveries=1.
